rubric.role_summary: Remote, hands-on implementation consultant for US law firms, building and deploying CRM, project-management, analytics, low-code/no-code automation, and AI solutions while analyzing operations and working directly with clients.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote, hands-on implementation consultant for US law firms, building and deploying CRM, project-management, analytics, low-code/no-code automation, and AI solutions while analyzing operations and working directly with clients.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Proven track record deploying and configuring one or more of CRMs, project-management systems, analytics dashboards, low-code/no-code automation tools, and AI applications; experience with every category is not required.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- 2+ years of experience in similar roles.
- Client-facing and/or consulting experience, especially with SMEs.
- Experience with CRMs, project-management/ERP systems, automation/iPaaS tools, GenAI, data analysis, and/or REST API integrations; the listed tools are examples, not a requirement to know them all.
- Portfolio showing projects that demonstrate a systematic problem-solving approach.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
No geographic filter: no concrete eligible location is stated; use the less restrictive interpretation.

source_quotes: Fully Remote, with quarterly in-person meetups in locations all over the globe chosen by popular vote of team members (potential lineup for next year: USA, Tokyo, Dubai, Bangkok)
Flexible Schedule, but availability needed for client meetings Mon - Fri, morning US hours (afternoon-evening Eastern European Time)

soft_requirements: Communicate technical concepts effectively to nontechnical law-firm staff and executives.
Use systems thinking to connect technical solutions with business outcomes and solve problems autonomously.
Enjoy building and refining systems with attention to detail.
Take ownership of work and client outcomes; learn new tools quickly and remain coachable.
Be comfortable with an intense, dynamic work environment rather than seeking a predictable, low-intensity schedule.
Align with the stated values of excellence, integrity, and care.
